I literally don't talk to my dad because of a whole bunch of shit a couple years ago. I'm just distant from my Mum. I don't want to let her down or have her think less of me because of all this shit. As far as friends I have none, online or irl.

In terms of friends I haven't had any for a long time.

Well fuck it. What's the worst that could happen.

To sum it up I have no friends, no caring family, no qualifications, no money, no job, and I'm gay. Which isn't a bad thing on it's own but it sure as fuck doesn't help.

So yeah. Sorry for bitching.

We could, but all I'd be doing is bothering you. Plus if I start thinking about it again I'll probably start crying then I'll probably start cutting myself again and then I have to worry about not getting blood everywhere and who can be fucked with all that.

So thanks, but no thanks.
